hotlines.name: Pasig City Emergency Hotline (Command Center / C3, operated by Pasig City DRRMO)
hotlines.notes: The main city emergency line for fire, rescue, medical and flood calls. The DRRMO Citizen's Charter calls it the 'Command Center Hotline'. DRRMO office: C3, Pasig City Hall, Caruncho Ave. DRRMO Research and Planning Division is 8643-0000 local 306. The city cited this number in its August 2026 habagat evacuation advisories.

hotlines.name: Pasig KaTXT (text line of the emergency hotline / DRRMO)
hotlines.notes: Text-only line. The DRRMO Citizen's Charter and the DILG-NCR iDRRM profile both list it as the DRRMO mobile number.

hotlines.name: Pasig City rescue line (older listing)
hotlines.notes: Listed as Pasig City's rescue hotline in news hotline roundups from 2020 (Typhoon Ulysses) and July 2024 (Typhoon Carina). Current official city posts use 8643-0000 instead, so this line may be outdated.

hotlines.name: Pasig City Hall Trunkline
hotlines.notes: Pasig Info (the city PIO) and pasigcity.gov.ph announced on 2024-04-14 that the trunkline was working again after a device migration. City Hall is on Caruncho Ave., Brgy. San Nicolas.

hotlines.name: Pasig City Traffic Department (Traffic and Parking Management Office)
hotlines.notes: Listed in the Pasig City telephone directory and in the TPMO Citizen's Charter. The directory gives tpmo@pasigcity.gov.ph as the office email.

hotlines.name: Pasig City Police Station (PNP, Eastern Police District)
hotlines.notes: Listed as 'Philippine National Police' on the city's official Emergency Contact Numbers post (July 24, 2024). National emergency line: 911.

hotlines.name: Bureau of Fire Protection - Pasig City Central Fire Station
hotlines.notes: Mobile number as posted on the official BFP NCR Pasig PIU Facebook page and on the city's Emergency Contact Numbers post. The station page gives V. Baltazar St., Sto. Tomas, Pasig City. For fire emergencies, the city's 8643-0000 line also dispatches.

hotlines.name: Pasig City General Hospital (PCGH)
hotlines.notes: LGU hospital on M. Eusebio Ave., Maybunga. The city's Emergency Contact Numbers post lists 8642-7379 and 8642-7381; the PhilHealth accredited-hospital list gives 8643-3333, 642-7379 and 642-7381. No source says which line reaches the ER.

hotlines.name: Pasig City Children's Hospital (PCCH) - Child's Hope
hotlines.notes: 15A Industria St. cor. Alcalde Jose St., Brgy. Kapasigan. The hospital's Citizen's Charter on pasigcity.gov.ph gives 8643-2222 local 601. Inquirer reported limited ER services from June 28, 2024, with the ER moved temporarily to the outpatient department.

hotlines.name: The Medical City (Ortigas) Emergency Department
hotlines.notes: ER locals 2222 or 2338; triage local 2341; trauma local 2340. From the official TMC site. The page does not say which branch it covers, but the page gives the address as Ortigas Avenue, Pasig City.

conflicts.text_fil: Walang nahanap na sangguniang nag-uugnay sa 8642-1111 sa anumang ahensya ng Pasig. Hindi pa kumpirmadong linya ito ng Command Center. Ayon sa opisyal na post ng Pasig Info, 8643-0000 ang emergency hotline at 8643-1111 ang pangunahing linya ng City Hall.
conflicts.text_en: No source found ties 8642-1111 to any Pasig agency; it is not confirmed as a Command Center line. The official Pasig Info post names 8643-0000 as the emergency hotline and 8643-1111 as the City Hall trunkline.

conflicts.text_fil: Hindi makumpirma ang landline ng BFP Pasig na 8641-2815. Ang cellphone number na 0932-779-8621 lang ang nakalista sa opisyal na pahina ng BFP NCR Pasig PIU at sa post ng lungsod.
conflicts.text_en: The BFP Pasig landline 8641-2815 could not be confirmed. Only the mobile 0932-779-8621 appears on the official BFP NCR Pasig PIU page and the city's post.

conflicts.text_fil: Nakalista sa mga news roundup noong 2020 at 2024 ang 8632-0099 bilang rescue line ng Lungsod ng Pasig, pero 8643-0000 na ang ginagamit sa mga kasalukuyang opisyal na post. Hindi tiyak kung gumagana pa ang 8632-0099.
conflicts.text_en: News roundups from 2020 and 2024 list 8632-0099 as Pasig City's rescue line, but current official posts use 8643-0000. It is unclear whether 8632-0099 still works.

conflicts.text_fil: Ang Citizen's Charter ng DRRMO (mga 2022) ay nagbibigay ng '641-1111 local 246' para sa Sangguniang Secretariat. Ipinahihiwatig nito na dating 8641-1111 ang trunkline; ang kasalukuyang trunkline ayon sa Pasig Info (Abril 2024) ay 8643-1111.
conflicts.text_en: The DRRMO Citizen's Charter (about 2022) gives the Sangguniang Secretariat as '641-1111 local 246'. This suggests the trunkline was once 8641-1111; the current trunkline per Pasig Info (April 2024) is 8643-1111.

conflicts.text_fil: Magkaiba ang listahan ng numero para sa Pasig City General Hospital: 8642-7379 at 8642-7381 sa post ng lungsod, at dagdag na 8643-3333 sa listahan ng PhilHealth. Walang nakitang numero para sa ER.
conflicts.text_en: Pasig City General Hospital numbers differ by source: the city post gives 8642-7379 and 8642-7381, while the PhilHealth list also gives 8643-3333. No source names the ER line.
